TOOLING BURST T1a-walk-3 — walk instrument: annotated-landmark path + mask-stability selector (SPEC § 6 row "T1a-walk-3"; conductor ruling R-27: two segmentation methods failed on the collotype while the instrument passes on clean masks — reference values now come from an ANNOTATE burst's landmarks; masks become a second, gated estimate). task_id "T1a-walk-3".

Read ONLY, in this order:
1. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/SPEC.md — § 0, § 1, § 6 rows "T1a-walk", "T1a-walk-2", "T1a-walk-3" (the -3 row is your contract).
2. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/BURST_RULES.md
3. astra_test_01/burst/oracle/{walk_landmarks.py, walk_curves.py, walk_bands.py}, tests/test_oracle_walk.py, gates/common.py; and the annotation file /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-1/artifacts/T1a-ann-13L/annotation.json (its schema is what --landmarks reads).
Do not read anything else. No web. No agents. No image generation. No pip install. stdlib + Pillow + numpy + scipy ONLY.

CONDUCTOR AMENDMENT (from the annotation itself): the 12 cells were cut from the plate by equal split, so ground_y varies by ~30 px across frames — EVERY vertical quantity on the annotation path (head bob, W-1, W-2, W-4, sole heights, H) must be computed RELATIVE TO THE PER-FRAME ground_y (height above ground), never absolute y; horizontal quantities are relative to the per-frame hip x. Say so in a docstring.

IMPLEMENT the four numbered items by modifying the walk modules in place (keep public functions). Revert figure_mask_row's DEFAULT to the T1a-walk method A (keep method B under a flag). The two currently-red walk tests may be re-scoped ONLY as the row says (the mask path's contact/scroll assertions now run on the synthetic walker's ALPHA masks, where they must pass; the collotype is no longer required to segment). Then RUN and report:
  (a) --landmarks /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-1/artifacts/T1a-ann-13L/annotation.json --label plate13_lateral_ann --fps 8.33 --out oracle/bands_walk.json --plot_dir runs/C-1/oracle/plots
  (b) --landmarks /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-1/artifacts/T1a-ann-13L/annotation.json --ref /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/fixtures/muybridge/plate13_lateral --pattern 'frame_*.png' --fps 8.33 --label plate13_lateral --out oracle/bands_walk.json --plot_dir runs/C-1/oracle/plots   (agreement block; mask estimate only if stable)
  (c) --ref /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/fixtures/muybridge/plate2_lateral --pattern 'frame_*.png' --fps 8.33 --label plate2_lateral --out oracle/bands_walk.json --plot_dir runs/C-1/oracle/plots   (mask path only; expect unstable → null)
Plot for (a): head y / head x / near+far sole x / wrist x over the 12 frames with the phase labels, plus frame 1 and frame 7 with the annotated points drawn. Muybridge is public domain.
Then run the FULL suite: `cd astra_test_01/burst && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -B tests/run_t0c.py` — expected all green except the four named T0-d3 reds; report exact counts.

DO NOT touch: lane/, oracles/, parts/, transcribe/, compare/, bible/, gates/ (read only), idle modules (read only), SPEC.md, BURST_RULES.md, REGISTER_CARD.md, JUDGE_RUBRIC.md, MANIFEST.sha256, briefs/, fixtures/. Under runs/ write ONLY runs/C-1/oracle/. Do not run git. Temporary files ONLY under tests/tmp/.

RETURN: the receipt (task_id "T1a-walk-3"): files with sha256; images []; calls_used 0; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED; concerns with numbers: the annotation-path W-1 %H, W-2 phases, W-3a/c, W-4, W-5 near/far, W-6, contacts, phase table, mean confidence; the mask stability CVs and whether the mask estimate was reported; the agreement block. Never PASS/FAIL.
